title: Sweet Chicken Tacos
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Mexican-inspired dish featuring chicken, sweet flavors, and crunchy tacos.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add diced sweet onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add taco seasoning, cumin, garlic powder (if using), salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the flavors are fragrant.
Warm tacos shells according to package instructions.
Assemble tacos by placing cooked chicken onto a warmed taco shell, followed by a spoonful of the onion mixture.
Top with shredded mexican cheese blend, a dollop of sour cream (if using), and serve immediately.
Garnish with your favorite toppings, such as diced tomatoes, shredded lettuce, or diced avocado.
